section.title: TPO PANEL
section.text:
read-only forward panel; columns only, no conditions pTpoPOC: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC session. pTpoVAH: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. pTpoVAL: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC session's 70% value area. dist_pTpoPOC: % from current price to pTpoPOC. dist_pTpoVAH: % from current price to pTpoVAH. dist_pTpoVAL: % from current price to pTpoVAL. pTpoVAL_open_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs open. pTpoVAH_open_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs open. pTpoVAL_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs close. pTpoVAH_close_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs close. pTpoPOC_close_spread: % gap pTpoPOC vs close. pTpoVAL_low_spread: % gap pTpoVAL vs low. pTpoVAH_high_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs high. pTpoVAH_pTpoVAL_spread: % gap pTpoVAH vs pTpoVAL. tpoPOC: the price bin holding the most time in the current UTC session, over 5-bps bins — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoPOC_pTpoPOC_spread: % gap tpoPOC vs pTpoPOC. tpoVAH: the upper edge of the 70% value area around the current UTC session's point of control — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent for the session's first 60 minutes. tpoVAH_tpoVAL_spread: % gap tpoVAH vs tpoVAL. tpoShape: where the point of control sits inside the current UTC session's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror — a point-in-time read at its own fold (p-shape / b-shape / balanced).
